verdict.rationale: Gladia documents JSON output (CLI offers JSON and machine-readable output). It also documents utterance-level structure: live final transcripts complete an utterance, maximum utterance duration is configurable, and diarization separates speakers. That shows the results are structured rather than a text blob. No evidence shows per-utterance or per-word confidence values or the actual API response schema. missing for 10: documented confidence values in responses, an API response schema showing utterances/segments with timestamps, independent or hands-on corroboration.
